The '''''Purgatory''-class prison ship''' was the modified version of the [[Porter-class transport|''Porter''-class transport]].

==Characteristics==
Over a kilometer in length, the design was blocky, box-like, and slow, but functional. However, the ship performed poorly if pressed into combat.<ref name="Ord Vaxal" />

The Purgatory wasn't able to go into the atmosphere, but equipped with two landing bays, each housing three [[Peth-class Shuttle|''Peth''-class transport shuttles]] and two TIE-fighters.<ref name="Ord Vaxal" />

The prison blocks were composed of many ten-prisoner cells, equipped with uncomfortable bunks.<ref name="Ord Vaxal" />

==History==
Being unsatisfied with the conditions inside the ''Porter''-class troop transports designed for the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]] modified the ships into prison vessels for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and renamed them the ''Purgatory''-class.<ref name="Ord Vaxal" />

During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], they were used on the prison planet [[Ord Vaxal]].<ref name="Ord Vaxal" />
